definitions.explanation: Describes a firm, unwavering attitude or manner, especially when facing opposition or difficult situations. Implies moral courage and steadfast determination.

examples.japanese: {毅然|きぜん}とした⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧{毅然|きぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{立|た}ち{向|む}かった→立ち向かう：06981_tachimukau⟧。
examples.english: She stood up resolutely against the injustice.

examples.japanese: {脅|おど}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{屈|くっ}せ→屈する：09142_kussuru⟧ず、{毅然|きぜん}とした⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{臨|のぞ}んだ→臨む：29038_nozomu⟧。
examples.english: Unfazed by threats, he approached the negotiations with a firm stance.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Almost always used adverbially as {毅然|きぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ or attributively as {毅然|きぜん}とした.

ADVERBIAL FORM: {毅然|きぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (resolutely, firmly)

NUANCE: {毅然|きぜん} conveys moral strength and the courage to stand firm on principles. It suggests dignified determination, not just stubbornness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {毅然|きぜん}とした⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (firm attitude)
- {毅然|きぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ (to refuse firmly)
- {毅然|きぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{立|た}ち{向|む}かう→立ち向かう：06981_tachimukau⟧ (to stand up resolutely)
- {毅然|きぜん}とした⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧ (unwavering stance)
